.ajx-ptn {
  --blue: #0256DB;
  --blue-d: #0243A8;
  --blue-dd: #012F7E;
  --navy: #1C244B;
  --green: #28A745;
  --green-d: #1E8A38;
  --leaf: #56A428;
  --lime: #6FC324;
  --sky: #DFEBFC;
  --sky-2: #AAD0F0;
  --gray: #F5F5F5;
  --amber: #F7B650;
  --text: #54595F;
  --muted: #7A7A7A;
  --ink: #16204A;
  --line: #E3E9F2;
  --r: 14px;
  --r-lg: 22px;
  --sh: 0 2px 4px rgba(28,36,75,.05), 0 14px 34px -16px rgba(2,67,168,.30);
  --sh-lg: 0 30px 70px -30px rgba(2,50,140,.5);
  --f-head: "Outfit", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  --f-body: "Nunito", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
  color-scheme: light;
}

.ajx-ptn *,
.ajx-ptn *::before,
.ajx-ptn *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.ajx-ptn {
  font: 400 16px/1.7 var(--f-body);
  color: var(--text);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

.ajx-ptn img {
  max-width: 100%;
  display: block;
}

.ajx-ptn a {
  color: inherit;
}

.ajx-ptn h1,
.ajx-ptn h2,
.ajx-ptn h3,
.ajx-ptn h4,
.ajx-ptn p,
.ajx-ptn ul,
.ajx-ptn ol,
.ajx-ptn dl,
.ajx-ptn dd,
.ajx-ptn figure {
  margin: 0;
}

.ajx-ptn ul,
.ajx-ptn ol {
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.ajx-ptn button {
  font: inherit;
  color: inherit;
}

.ajx-ptn button {
  cursor: pointer;
}

.ajx-ptn :focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid #6FA6FF;
  outline-offset: 3px;
  border-radius: 8px;
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .sr {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0 0 0 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .center {
  text-align: center;
  margin-top: 44px;
}

html {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
  scroll-padding-top: 90px;
}



/* ==========================================================================
   ANIMATIONS
   ========================================================================== */

@keyframes ajx-rise {
  0% { transform: translate(0, 0); opacity: 0; }
  10% { opacity: 1; }
  100% { transform: translate(24px, -120vh); opacity: .2; }
}

/* ==========================================================================
   BUTTONS
   The .btn family — used by almost every section (Hero, Bread/Water adverts,
   Purify, CTA, ...)
   ========================================================================== */

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 12px 24px;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 10px;
  text-decoration: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
  font: 600 15.5px var(--f-head);
  letter-spacing: .01em;
  color: #fff;
  transition: transform .25s var(--ease), box-shadow .25s var(--ease), background-color .25s;
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .btn:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .btn:active {
  transform: scale(.98);
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .btn--lg {
  padding: 15px 30px;
  font-size: 16.5px;
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .btn--block {
  width: 100%;
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .btn--green {
  background: var(--green);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 24px -12px rgba(40,167,69,.9);
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .btn--green:hover {
  background: var(--green-d);
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .btn--blue {
  background: var(--blue);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 24px -12px rgba(2,86,219,.9);
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .btn--blue:hover {
  background: var(--blue-d);
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .btn--ghost-light {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.1);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(255,255,255,.55);
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .btn--ghost-light:hover {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.2);
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .btn-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-top: 30px;
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .btn-row--center {
  justify-content: center;
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .btn--white {
  background: #fff;
  color: var(--green-d);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 26px -14px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .btn--white:hover {
  background: #F2FFF5;
}

  /* --- Responsive: Phones, 640px and below --- */
  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    .ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .btn-row .btn {
      flex: 1 1 auto;
    }

  }



/* ==========================================================================
   BUBBLES
   The floating-bubble background decoration — used by Hero, Water advert,
   Purify, CTA
   ========================================================================== */

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .bubbles {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .bubbles i {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -70px;
  width: var(--s);
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 32% 28%, rgba(255,255,255,.95) 0 7%, rgba(255,255,255,.2) 22%, rgba(255,255,255,.05) 62%);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.4);
  animation: ajx-rise var(--d) linear infinite;
  animation-delay: var(--dl);
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .bubbles i:nth-child(1) {
  left: 5%;
  --s: 30px;
  --d: 17s;
  --dl: -3s;
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .bubbles i:nth-child(2) {
  left: 14%;
  --s: 12px;
  --d: 12s;
  --dl: -8s;
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .bubbles i:nth-child(3) {
  left: 24%;
  --s: 46px;
  --d: 23s;
  --dl: -14s;
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .bubbles i:nth-child(4) {
  left: 37%;
  --s: 16px;
  --d: 14s;
  --dl: -2s;
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .bubbles i:nth-child(5) {
  left: 49%;
  --s: 60px;
  --d: 27s;
  --dl: -18s;
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .bubbles i:nth-child(6) {
  left: 58%;
  --s: 10px;
  --d: 11s;
  --dl: -6s;
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .bubbles i:nth-child(7) {
  left: 67%;
  --s: 34px;
  --d: 20s;
  --dl: -11s;
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .bubbles i:nth-child(8) {
  left: 78%;
  --s: 18px;
  --d: 15s;
  --dl: -1s;
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .bubbles i:nth-child(9) {
  left: 87%;
  --s: 50px;
  --d: 25s;
  --dl: -9s;
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .bubbles i:nth-child(10) {
  left: 95%;
  --s: 14px;
  --d: 13s;
  --dl: -5s;
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .bubbles--sm i {
  --s: 20px;
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .bubbles--sm i:nth-child(n+7) {
  display: none;
}



/* ==========================================================================
   LAYOUT
   Elementor Container plumbing: the flex split/column system, boxed-width
   gutters, the hidden 'keep this block' label, shared section headings
   (kicker/title/lede), and the scroll-reveal animation system. Not page
   content — change this only if you understand the layout, not the design.
   ========================================================================== */

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .section,
.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n).section {
  padding-block: clamp(64px, 8vw, 110px);
  position: relative;
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .section--gray,
.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n).section--gray {
  background: var(--gray);
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .kicker {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 6px 16px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--sky);
  color: var(--blue);
  font: 600 14px var(--f-head);
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .kicker--center {
  margin-inline: auto;
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .title {
  font: 700 clamp(30px, 3.6vw, 44px)/1.15 var(--f-head);
  letter-spacing: -.015em;
  color: var(--blue);
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .lede {
  margin-top: 16px;
  font-size: 17px;
  color: var(--muted);
  text-align: left;
  max-width: 60ch;
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .head-center {
  text-align: center;
  display: grid;
  justify-items: center;
  margin-bottom: clamp(30px, 4vw, 50px);
}

html.ajx-js body:not(.elementor-editor-active) .ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .rv {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(24px);
  transition: opacity .8s var(--ease), transform .8s var(--ease);
  transition-delay: calc(var(--i, 0) * 80ms);
}

html.ajx-js body:not(.elementor-editor-active) .ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .rv.in {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: none;
}

html.ajx-js body:not(.elementor-editor-active) .ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .value.rv.in:hover,
html.ajx-js body:not(.elementor-editor-active) .ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .post.rv.in:hover {
  transform: translateY(-8px);
}

.ajx-global {
  min-height: 0!important;
}

body.elementor-editor-active .ajx-global .elementor-widget-html {
  min-height: 22px;
}

body.elementor-editor-active .ajx-global .elementor-widget-html::before {
  content: "Ajalisco homepage styles & scripts \2014 keep this block";
  display: block;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  font: 12px/1.2 sans-serif;
  color: #555;
  background: #fff7d6;
  border: 1px dashed #d9b84a;
}

.ajx-fill {
  position: absolute!important;
  inset: 0;
  width: auto!important;
  max-width: none!important;
  margin: 0!important;
  pointer-events: none;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.ajx-fill>.elementor-widget-container {
  height: 100%;
}

.ajx-back {
  z-index: -1;
}

.ajx-wave {
  position: absolute!important;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  width: auto!important;
  max-width: none!important;
  margin: 0!important;
  height: clamp(50px,6vw,90px);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n).e-con-boxed,
.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .e-con-boxed {
  padding-inline: clamp(16px,4vw,36px)!important;
}

.ajx-ptn:not(#ajx-n) .ajx-split {
  flex-direction: row!important;
  flex-wrap: nowrap!important;
